articles.title: TotalEnergies (ENXTPA:TTE) Ties Up $1.8 Billion For African Infrastructure
articles.summary: TotalEnergies (ENXTPA:TTE) agreed a $1.8b infrastructure partnership with Global Infrastructure Partners, a BlackRock unit, focused on African oil and gas assets. The transaction centers on midstream infrastructure, giving TotalEnergies additional access to capital tied to its African energy projects.
